verdict.rationale: A dedicated first-party help article documents Scheduled tasks in Claude Cowork. These are tasks that 'run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand', and Claude delivers finished reports, briefings, and summaries 'on your schedule'. The supporting Cowork docs confirm Claude carries out multi-step work autonomously while you step away. Missing for 10: details of scheduling controls (cadence options, editing, pausing, run history), and independent or hands-on corroboration that recurring runs work reliably.
